governed_by: HG-KSEOS (normative/control plane: admission, WorkOrder, Spine, release gate)

what_was_learned.lesson: An unmerged pull request already exposes merge_commit_sha, and it is a PREVIEW commit that is not on main; recording it as a merge is a false success.
what_was_learned.measured_on: PR #14 during the transient mergeable=null window: REST reported merged=false with merge_commit_sha=c3ac660a while main was 603cb0cb and did not contain it
what_was_learned.next_round_action: Gate every merge claim on `merged: true` AND on a fresh read of main's tip, never on merge_commit_sha alone.

what_was_learned.lesson: mergeable: null / mergeable_state: unknown is GitHub's post-merge recomputation window, not a conflict; the correct behaviour is to HOLD, then merge on a later settle-and-reread run, and never blind-retry the write.
what_was_learned.measured_on: after #12 merged, #13 and #14 both read mergeable=null; both then merged cleanly once two surfaces agreed (REST mergeable=true and GraphQL MERGEABLE/CLEAN)
what_was_learned.next_round_action: Keep the merge idempotent (rerun reads back instead of re-merging) and confirm mergeability on a second surface before writing.

what_was_learned.lesson: A multi-stage evidence pack must parent to the branch TIP and use the TIP's tree as base_tree, or the later commit silently drops every file the earlier stage added.
what_was_learned.measured_on: publisher patched before the first write: parents=[main_sha] with main's tree was the exact shape that deleted a previous round's .md files mid-pack
what_was_learned.next_round_action: Bind parent and base_tree to the same commit object in every publishing stage.

what_was_learned.lesson: A self-check must be able to FAIL for the artifact's reason and not for the harness's. Three of this round's twelve checks failed on harness bugs (a double JSON parse, a null subscript behind .get(k, default), and a vacuous all() over an empty list) while the merged pull requests were correct throughout.
what_was_learned.measured_on: C02/C04/C12 FAIL -> PASS after fixing the checks, with live evidence unchanged (main bcd91043, prefixes 33/55/83)
what_was_learned.next_round_action: Treat a FAIL as a claim about the check first, fix the check, and re-derive the artifact state from the remote; never adjust evidence to satisfy a probe.

what_was_learned.lesson: An injected-mutation harness is what keeps a self-check honest: it must run in the SAME invocation as the checks, and a mutation whose exception is swallowed will be reported as 'undetected' when the real cause is the harness.
what_was_learned.measured_on: 16/16 mutations detected only after the mutation row started carrying the exception text
what_was_learned.landed_in: same reference :: ## 10 (fifth bullet) and the existing ## 5 (negative-control rule)
what_was_learned.next_round_action: Refuse the round's self-check verdict whenever the control reports any undetected mutation, and never swallow the mutation's exception.

what_was_learned.lesson: Contract fields bound to acceptance edges cannot be renamed by a follow-on round without inventing an acceptance edge; the honest move is to keep the bound identifier and disclose the lineage in the round's errata.
what_was_learned.measured_on: PL-009 deliverable/journey edge errors in the first lint run of this round's C0-C9 contract
what_was_learned.next_round_action: When reusing a compiler-clean contract, list every carried identifier and state what it now names.

iteration_effects_this_round: The publisher was corrected BEFORE any remote write (parent/base_tree), so the multi-stage loss was prevented rather than repaired.
The A08 verdict rule was corrected after it scored a fully merged round as PARTIAL; the first receipt already said PARTIAL and that defect is disclosed rather than overwritten silently.
The secrets scanner proved non-vacuity with a positive control firing six rule families and a clean control firing none, so its 0 findings are a measurement and not an absence of measurement.
explicitly_not_learned_or_claimed: Nothing here asserts validation of the archival scripts stored inside the three prefixes; they were archived, never executed.
Nothing here upgrades the deferred findings (TS-VAL-01, TS-CHECKER-01, TS-G1-01, the remaining owner items) or the eight runtime gates.
No cross-model independence is claimed: EXECUTE and VERIFY ran the same model, so model-axis SoD remains ABSENT.

artifact_disclosure.self_referential_receipts: This commit cannot contain its own publish/readback receipt: PUBLISH_RECEIPT_ARCHIVE.json, REMOTE_READBACK_ARCHIVE.json and PACK_INDEX.json are excluded from the archived tree by design (an index or receipt that describes a commit cannot be inside it). Their digests and the final per-blob readback live in the round directory and in the pull-request body.
artifact_disclosure.readback: every file that IS in the tree was verified byte-exact against the remote git blob identity sha1("blob <len>\0" + bytes)
